<h2>Resolve a Feasible Grouped Cross-Validation Design</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Preserves feasible initial assignments, otherwise tests increasing grouped
fold counts before the existing leave-one-location-out fallback. No models
are fitted during this search and no feasibility threshold is relaxed.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>resolve_cross_validation_fold_search(
  data_locations = NULL,
  data_assignments = NULL,
  data_partition_diagnostics = NULL,
  data_community_matrix = NULL,
  config_data_processing = NULL,
  config_cross_validation = NULL,
  grouped_fold_ladder = base::c(5L, 10L, 20L, 50L),
  verbose = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code>, <code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code>, <code id="data_partition_diagnostics">data_partition_diagnostics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Initial location, assignment, and training-partition diagnostic tables.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_community_matrix">data_community_matrix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Binary response matrix aligned with location row indices.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="config_data_processing">config_data_processing</code></td>
<td>
<p>Processing configuration with 'min_n_cores', 'min_n_samples', 'min_n_taxa'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="config_cross_validation">config_cross_validation</code></td>
<td>
<p>CV controls including MEM threshold, repeats, assignment seed, and grid.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="grouped_fold_ladder">grouped_fold_ladder</code></td>
<td>
<p>Strictly increasing unique integer fold counts, all at least two.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verbose">verbose</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical. Print selected design and candidate-fold task estimates if TRUE.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list containing unchanged-schema 'data_assignments', attempt-level
'data_fold_search', partition-level 'data_partition_diagnostics_search',
and the configured 'vec_grouped_fold_ladder'.
Failed grids are recorded; unexpected errors propagate. All configured
repeats must pass. The search never tries counts at or above location count.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
list_search &lt;-
  resolve_cross_validation_fold_search(
    data_locations = data_cross_validation_locations,
    data_assignments = data_cross_validation_assignments_initial,
    data_partition_diagnostics =
      data_cross_validation_partition_diagnostics_initial,
    data_community_matrix = data_community_filtered,
    config_data_processing = config_data_processing,
    config_cross_validation = config_model_fitting[["cross_validation"]]
  )

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
